title: Microbiology Operations & Time Optimization in Sepsis
official: A Simulation Platform for Optimising Blood Culture Diagnostics in Sepsis
summary: The goal of this study is to simulate turn-around times of blood cultures from blood culture collection to final communication of the result. The main objective is to develop a web-based tool that is able to simulate heterogeneous laboratory settings and to analyse the impact of infrastructure and opening hours on blood culture turn-around times.
criteria: microbiological laboratories conducting blood culture analysis
central: Evgeny A Idelevich, MD, Prof. · Evgeny.Idelevich@med.uni-greifswald.de
